title: Run summary
description: One reduced per-boot telemetry dataset, materialized by analytics/reduce into the per-repo state node at <node>/analytics/runs/<boot-id>/run-summary.json. Consumed by the dashboard (Elixir Presenter, prior-boot reads) and by Executor tools (run-summary, build-report). Materialization is a cache, never a source of truth: every summary is regenerable from its declared source_files, and provenance identifies the sources.

schema_version.description: run-summary schema version. Distinct from the telemetry record schema_version carried on each record.

boot_id.description: The daemon boot this summary reduces.

generated_at.description: When the summary was materialized (UTC ISO-8601).

source_files.description: Expanded telemetry files the reducer consumed.

source_bytes.description: Total bytes of the source files consumed, so a partial or rotated source is detectable.

records.description: Normalized telemetry envelopes retained for this boot.

actors.description: Per-actor resource samples, profile statistics, gaps, and availability counts.

tickets.description: Per-ticket lifecycle events, intervals, dispatch complexity, and findings.

enrich.description: true when GitHub enrichment was applied; enrich is an explicit opt-in.
